# Vendored Apache ECharts

`echarts.common.min.js` is the unmodified "common" build (line, bar, scatter,
pie, and the grid, tooltip, legend, dataZoom, toolbox and mark components) of
Apache ECharts 6.1.0, copied from the npm package so the static dashboard
loads no code from a CDN.
